summary: Iter 43 - Verified Hutang pay-date routing and Cash Flow line chart. Backend 5/5 pytest passed: credit purchase (amount_paid < total) emits only initial 'Bayar awal' pembelian event on PO date; POST /api/purchases/{id}/pay with explicit date stores payment at that date with info 'Bayar hutang supplier (pembelian <PO_DATE>)' and populates /reports/cash/day on the pay date; /reports/cash/daily rows for pay month include the pembelian + keluar + saldo_berjalan (chart-ready); amount<=0 => 400; overpayment capped to total (status lunas); total kas (no period) >= sum of per-month pembelian so no double counting across months; /hutang listing shows sebagian entries with correct sisa. Also re-ran iter42 piutang suite: 5/5 still green. Frontend: Hutang & Piutang pay modal on HUTANG tab now exposes data-testid=hp-pay-date with label 'Tanggal uang dibayarkan' (seeded sebagian purchase via API; UI click Bayar opened modal; submitted amount 10k + date 2026-01-05; backend persisted payments[0].date='2026-01-05T...'; toast 'Pembayaran dicatat'). Laba Rugi 'Rincian Arus Kas Harian' card renders a line chart data-testid=cash-flow-chart ABOVE the table, with 3 lines (Saldo Berjalan, Uang Keluar, Uang Masuk) in both Bulanan and Tahunan modes; tooltip shows date + 'Rp 0' / 'Rp 251.200' etc. for the three series. No blocking console errors (only initial recharts 'width(-1)/height(-1)' warnings on first mount — self-resolving once ResponsiveContainer measures; non-blocking).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py pay_purchase (line 1166): stores payments[].date as f'{data.date[:10]}T{now_iso()[11:]}' (date + current time-of-day). Consistent with pay_transaction, so cash_events slicing [:10] works. Minor: consider storing pure YYYY-MM-DD or a separate 'at' timestamp for clarity (same note as iter42).
pay_purchase does NOT require admin (uses get_current_user) — kasir can pay hutang. Matches pay_transaction behavior but may be intentional/unintentional; flagging for product owner.

CashFlowChart.jsx: initial render produces recharts warning 'width(-1) and height(-1)' until ResponsiveContainer measures; harmless but noisy. Can wrap in a style={{ width: '100%' }} or render only after rows load to suppress.
CashFlowChart.fillDays uses new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10) for today — fine, but server clock is 2026-10, so for 2027+ periods the chart will stop at 'today'. Expected per app design.
Still no DELETE endpoint for /api/purchases/{id} — leftover test data from UI flows requires direct Mongo cleanup. Minor dev-ergonomics issue (not user-facing).
